title: Target A Markup-Affected Area
task: Using docxedit only, identify one target ID that appears to be affected by tracked changes or comment markup.
Use privacy-safe commands first. If you need read or dump, keep --max-text small and do not repeat private text in the final response.
Compare final, original, or markup views only as needed to understand how docxedit exposes the target.
Report only target IDs, change IDs or types, command outcomes, and usability observations.
successCriteria: Uses changes and at least one target-oriented command such as dump, find, read, or outline.
Avoids raw OOXML inspection and non-docxedit document tooling.
Final response does not quote private content.
Explains whether the target IDs are sufficient to navigate from markup inventory to document context.
observerQuestions: Could the agent bridge change records to editable targets?
Did it know when to use --view markup?
Did the CLI force it to expose too much text?
